facts.statement: Sokotosuchus lived during the Maastrichtian in western Africa.
facts.quote: which existed during the Maastrichtian in western Africa

facts.statement: Fossils of Sokotosuchus were found in the Dukamaje Formation of Nigeria.
facts.quote: Fossils of the genus were found in the Dukamaje Formation of Nigeria

facts.statement: Some cranial material of Sokotosuchus has possibly been found in Mali.
facts.quote: and some cranial material has possibly been found in Mali

facts.statement: The genus Sokotosuchus was described by Halstead in 1975.
The type species of Sokotosuchus is Sokotosuchus ianwilsoni.
Sokotosuchus belongs to the family Dyrosauridae.
Sokotosuchus is classified within the superorder Crocodylomorpha.
Sokotosuchus lived in the Sokoto region of Nigeria, Africa, during the Eocene.
facts.quote: que vivió en la zona de Sokoto, Nigeria, en África durante el Eoceno

facts.statement: Sokotosuchus appears to have been a close relative of Phosphatosaurus.
facts.quote: Parece haber sido un pariente cercano a Phosphatosaurus

facts.statement: The subfamily name Phosphatosaurinae was proposed for Sokotosuchus and Phosphatosaurus, but it remains tentative due to poor knowledge of their anatomy.
facts.quote: el cual lo denominó Phosphatosaurinae, pero dicho nombre ha permanecido de manera tentativa, debido al pobre conocimiento de la anatomía de estas dos especies

facts.statement: Sokotosuchus lived from the Maastrichtian to the Thanetian, between 72.2 and 56 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Maastrichtian to Thanetian (72.2 to 56 million years ago)

facts.statement: The parent group of Sokotosuchus is Phosphatosaurinae.

rejected.statement: Sokotosuchus is an extinct genus of dyrosaurid crocodyliform.
rejected.quote: Sokotosuchus is an extinct genus of dyrosaurid crocodyliform
